mapper.sql: c.id, c.provider_code, p.display_name AS provider_name, c.base_url, c.status, c.last_verified_at, c.created_at, d.id AS credential_id, d.masked_hint, d.status AS credential_status, d.created_at AS credential_created_at
FROM provider_connections c JOIN providers p ON p.code = c.provider_code LEFT JOIN provider_credentials d ON d.connection_id = c.id AND d.status <> 'REVOKED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_connections (id, user_public_id, provider_code, base_url, status, last_verified_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userPublicId}, #{providerCode}, #{baseUrl}, #{status}, #{lastVerifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select:
